The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Foundry/Legends|Foundry]]''' ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
The Governor claimed that Foundry's defenses made the planet impregnable, with fleets and spies being incapable of reaching the world alive, much less escape from its facilities. Despite this boast, a small Rebel team of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Mici Shabandar]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] managed to both infiltrate and escape with an experimental Imperial warship, the ''[[Staraker]]''.
